ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $l_{1}\colon y=ax-b$ and the line $l_{2}\colon y=kx$ are in the same Cartesian coordinate system. What is the solution set for the inequality $ax-b>kx$ in terms of $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} When $x < -1$, we have $ax - b > kx$. \\
Therefore, the solution set of the inequality $ax - b > kx$ with respect to $x$ is $x < -1$, \\
thus the answer is: $\boxed{x < -1}$.
